description: Figure 3 is a donut chart titled “Stimulus Type,” illustrating the distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs in WildChat conversations matched to online articles. The chart is divided into nine distinct colored segments, each labeled with its category and corresponding percentage: “Draft/Other” (26.4%, dark red), “Press Release” (18.7%, yellow), “External News Article” (18.1%, dark green), “Interview” (8.8%, purple), “Organizational Report” (7.7%, light purple), “Event Posting” (6.6%, dark brown), “Organizational Website” (4.9%, dark blue), “Intra-agency news article” (4.9%, dark blue), and “Email” (2.7%, light green). “Social Media Post” (1.1%, light gray) is also listed but appears as a very small segment near the top. The chart includes percentage labels directly on each slice, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size around the center. There is no legend, and no slices are visually emphasized (e.g., exploded or bolded).
